blocks.text: Mikha Lim of P-pop powerhouse BINI received both support and backlash after the incident involving her use of a cellphone while driving, that prompted the Land Transportation Office (LTO) to suspend her driver’s license. Lim had apologized for the incident and taken full accountability after the LTO issued her a show-cause order (SCO). The P-pop artist had also voluntarily appeared before the LTO ahead of her scheduled Nov. 20 appearance. “This has been a big lesson for me to be much more mindful, disciplined, and responsible moving forward.
